title: Add skills from skill_hub
placeholder: Paste a skill_hub skill page URL
help: Find a skill on the site, then paste its page URL or choose the downloaded .tar.gz file. Review the preview and acknowledge permissions before installing.
sizeHelp: Archives are limited to 20 MiB compressed, 64 MiB expanded and 10,000 entries.
catalogue: The default catalogue includes skills with the same names: {names}. You can enable the catalogue copies in the list instead of installing.
catalogueUnavailable: Could not read the default catalogue to check for skills with the same names.
snapshot: Archive SHA-256: {digest}. Changes on the site are not fetched automatically after installation.
trust: I understand that skills from {source} run with the AI agent's full permissions and agree to install them.

errors.url: Enter a skill page URL on a configured skill_hub site.
errors.download: Could not download the skill archive. Check the site connection or choose a downloaded file.
errors.size: The archive exceeds the size or entry limit. Choose a smaller archive.
errors.archive: Could not read the archive. Choose a .tar.gz containing one skill folder with SKILL.md. Links and parent paths are not allowed.
errors.input: Enter a skill page URL or choose a .tar.gz file.
errors.request: Could not load the skill preview. Try again.
